<module id="div_16bit">
    <description>Implements a 16-bit unsigned division. Given a dividend (A) and a divisor (B), calculates the quotient (result) and the remainder (odd). Each iteration compares the most significant bits of the current remainder and the divisor. If the remainder's MSBs are larger, sets the corresponding bit of the quotient to 1, and adjusts the remainder for the next comparison. Otherwise, sets the quotient bit to 0, and retains the original remainder unchanged. Shifts the remainder left to prepare for the next iteration. The process repeats for each bit of the dividend. The final result and remainder are updated after all iterations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[15:0]">Dividend.</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">Divisor.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">Quotient.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">Remainder.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
    
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="a_reg[15:0]" value="A[15:0]"/>
        <assign id="b_reg[7:0]" value="B[7:0]"/>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        integer i;
        // Registers to store the dividend and divisor values
        reg [15:0] a_reg;
        reg [7:0] b_reg;
        
        // Internal variables
        reg [15:0] remainder;
        reg [15:0] temp_remainder;
        reg [15:0] result;
        reg [15:0] odd;
        
        initial begin
            a_reg = 0;
            b_reg = 0;
            remainder = 0;
            result = 0;
            odd = 0;
        end
        
        always @(A, B) begin
            // Update the registers with the input values
            a_reg <= A;
            b_reg <= B;
            
            // Initialize the remainder to be zero
            remainder <= 0;
            
            // Perform the division operation
            for(i = 15; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
                if(remainder[i + 1 -: 9] >= b_reg) begin
                    result[i] <= 1;
                    remainder[i + 1 -: 9] <= remainder[i + 1 -: 9] - b_reg;
                end else begin
                    result[i] <= 0;
                    remainder[i + 1 -: 9] <= remainder[i + 1 -: 9];
                end
                
                // Shift the remainder to the left by one position
                remainder <= {remainder[i + 1 -: 8], a_reg[i]};
                
                // Check if we have reached the least significant bit of the dividend
                if(i == 0) begin
                    break;
                end
            end
            
            // Assign the calculated quotient and remainder to the output ports
            odd <= remainder;
            result <= result;
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
